name: revela_stereo_imx219_basic
description: Two eyes running the SAME chain, described once as a subsystem and instantiated twice. Every block inside still gets its own instance path and its own base address -- left.blacklevel and right.blacklevel are independent registers -- so the register map is byte-identical to spelling the graph out twice. What changes is the emitted RTL: one blacklevel module instantiated per eye, instead of two identical copies.

subsystems.name: eye
subsystems.description: One eye: remove the pedestal, balance the illuminant, and tap the pre-balance stream for metering.

inputs.name: sensor
inputs.description: Raw Bayer from this eye's sensor.

nodes.description: Per-eye white balance: the eyes may not see the same illuminant (windows, mixed light).

connections.description: A TAP: statistics meter the pedestal-corrected signal and produce no pixels, so the image path runs straight through.
